meta.notes: Polls Airtable Posts table every hour for records where Content Status = Posted and Repurposed = false and Instagram Caption is not empty. For each matching post, generates Twitter thread, LinkedIn post, blog intro, email snippet, and Pinterest description using Claude Haiku, then saves them back to the Airtable record and marks Repurposed = true.
setupRequired: 1. In n8n Credentials, create an HTTP Header Auth credential for Anthropic API (header name: x-api-key, value: your Anthropic API key)
3. After import, open the workflow and reconnect credentials in the two Airtable nodes and the HTTP Request node
